versions.changelog:
- Documentation in SKILL.md was updated for clarity and formatting.
- No changes to the code or logic; this release is documentation-only.
- Examples, tables, and descriptions in the skill reference were improved for easier understanding.

- Adds detailed classification of visual content requests into 17 structured types across 4 categories.
- Provides clear layout rules, visual mode constraints (Pure Visual, Educational, CTA), and generation hints for each content type.
- Introduces a Python API for content type detection, configuration retrieval, and filtering by industry, category, or visual mode.
- Includes confidence-based detection logic with fallbacks and well-documented return structure.
- Documents full configuration data structures and best practices for generating on-brand, layout-specific content.
